title: Let's Share Rebrand
description: Let's Share is a premium food brand in Muscat that creates sharing boxes for all kinds of gatherings. The goal of this rebrand was to improve the brand without changing what made it special. I kept the original idea and plated it out cohesively back tying the food with the gestures.
client: Let's Share founder, Marwa, reached out to me with hopes of taking her brand to the next level. Her cloud kitchen had already turned into a restaurant and now she was ready to invest in enhancing her overall brand outlook.

title: Wasta Branding
description: The project covered brand strategy, visual identity and packaging design, bringing Sarah’s vision to life through a playful, recognisable identity. A custom bilingual logo, warm earthy colours and geometric Omani motifs formed the visual foundation, while detailed packaging illustrations gave each blend its own character within a cohesive product family.
client: Sarah, co-founder of Wasta, approached HummingBird with the name “Wasta” already in mind and a vision for an Omani coffee alternative made from roasted date seeds. She wanted a brand that reflected its Arabian roots, commitment to sustainability and the sense of connection behind the name.
